title: dev.qory.run.step_exited
description: A step of the run ended. One per step, after the step's dev.qory.run.step_started and after every dev.qory.run.log of the step, and before dev.qory.run.exited. A run the gateway ends during a step has none for it in the run's stream: the gateway writes the open session's dev.qory.session.exited and the run's dev.qory.run.exited alone, and the session writes the step's dev.qory.run.step_exited in session.jsonl alone, with the step's outcome.

step.description: The number of the step in the run, from 1: the step of its dev.qory.run.step_started.

state.description: How the step ended: succeeded, failed or cancelled, the values of dev.qory.run.exited's state but paused. succeeded: the step ended well; failed: it ended badly; cancelled: it was stopped before it ended.

exit_code.description: The exit status of the step's process, as exit_code of dev.qory.run.exited is: -1 when no process exit status exists, such as for a step that runs no process.

duration_ms.description: Milliseconds from the step's dev.qory.run.step_started to its end.

reason.description: Why an after step or a container step ended otherwise than by its command's exit; no other step has one. timeout: the command ran past SessionSpec.AfterTimeout, or the step's time limit, and was stopped, cancelled. out_of_memory: the kernel killed a process of the step's container for lack of memory while the step ran, failed.
